messages:
liam: Quick heads-up 5B0 Skyline Analytics is live with EmbedHub via GCP Marketplace and they're using Redwood Private (VPC) as the inference layer. Launch completed this morning. :tada:

sophia: Amazing. Any early perf numbers from the benchmark runs?

liam: Early results: embedding throughput up ~1.8x for batch index writes; k-NN search latency down ~28% with prefix cache + quantized model. They picked our int8 quantized variant for the smaller memory footprint.

kevin: Nice win. Did they go with single-tenant Dedicated or our Private control plane?

maya: Private control plane + on-prem inference nodes behind VPC. They also requested KMS rotation and audit logs. Ops already enabled HSM KMS integration.

ops-bot: GCP Marketplace listing published: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/products/skyline/embedhub-example-listing 10: status ACTIVE.

zara: Marketing  note: we'll need a 3-sentence customer quote + a 1-paragraph tech note for the product blog. Can product/security approve the blurb?

liam: I'll arrange a 15-min quote call with Skyline's CTO for tomorrow at 11am ET. SDK consent form in the invite.

sophia: Sales requested a reference tag for renewal playbooks. Ref ID: REF-SKY-001. Added to CRM.

kevin: Small ops item: the customer asked for per-route token billing breakdown and 30-day logs retention for compliance. Ticket filed: INF-4319.

maya: For the engineering blog, here's a short snippet showing the deployment config they used:

```
redwood.deploy(
  name="embedhub-skyline",
  model="embed-opt-2b",
  variant="int8",
  mode="private",
  network={"vpc": "projects/skyline-prod/vpc0"},
  autoscale={"min":3, "max":12}
)
```

zara: Perfect. Marketing will write the external post and social copy; will include the ROI stat (28% latency improvement) and the security callouts (VPC + KMS).

liam: One more: Skyline chose to enable adaptive batching for peak match queries. We saw a ~22% cost reduction in the pilot when combined with cache hit rates.

sophia: Can engineering produce a small diagram for the blog? Pinged design with request DGN-807.

marketing-bot: Draft post uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/example 60 Please review by EOD.

kevin: Closing loop for launch ops - all runbooks and escalation contacts shared with the customer. Congrats team! :rocket:
